title: Architecture
lead: Docker runs the services. Traefik is only the 80/443 ingress. Lines are live traffic: the public internet enters Traefik, then each Compose is reached by LAN IP and host port. Drag a node. Click one to keep only its lines.
hint: Dev comes first. Secure follows the slash. The same port on two NAS machines does not collide, because the IP differs.
empty: Click a node to read its ports.

internet.title: Internet
internet.body: The public network only sees the router.

router.title: Router
router.body: Forwards only 80 and 443 to the NAS that runs Traefik.

traefik.title: NFX-Edge Traefik
traefik.body: File routes in dynamic/*.project.yml. No Docker network.

news.title: NFX-News
news.body: Block 10050–10079. Identity is dialed on its host gRPC port.

storages.title: NFX-Storages
storages.body: Block 10080–10109. S3 is a Host route. Other APIs strip /nfx-storages.

edge.title: NFX-Edge services
edge.body: Block 10110–10119. sites-base owns certificates. ACME stays on port 80.

documentation.title: NFX-Documentation
documentation.body: Block 10120–10129. Browser /documentation/ is rewritten inside the container.

sites.title: Static sites
sites.body: Outside the NFX blocks, starting at 10400.

stack.title: NFX-Stack
stack.body: Block 10000–10029. Products use the NAS IP plus these ports. No shared network.

nas2.title: NAS2
nas2.body: 192.168.1.65. Same port numbers as NAS1. Traefik only changes the IP in the URL.
